say:3:1122204001:1.text: What are you in the market for? A hunting rifle, bullets, or maybe some explosives?
say:3:1122204001:1.source_cn: 您准备买点什么？猎枪、子弹，还是炸药？
say:3:1122204001:1.male: What are you in the market for? A hunting rifle, bullets, or maybe some explosives?
say:3:1122204001:1.female: What are you in the market for? A hunting rifle, bullets, or maybe some explosives?

say:4:1122204002:1.text: We're here to find secrets—mhff, stop covering Chippy's mouth!
say:4:1122204002:1.source_cn: 老板，我们是来买情——唔唔唔，漫漫！你干嘛捂我的嘴！？

say:5:1122204003:1.text: Stupid Chippy, don't go blurting stuff like that!
say:5:1122204003:1.source_cn: 笨满满，这种时候就不要乱说话了！

choice_prompt:6:1122204003.text: Stupid Chippy, don't go blurting stuff like that!
choice_prompt:6:1122204003.source_cn: 笨满满，这种时候就不要乱说话了！

say:7:1122204004:1.text: Darn, I thought I was gonna get a big sale today! But turns out you're just after some information.
say:7:1122204004:1.source_cn: 哎呀哎呀，我还以为来了桩大买卖，没想到只是想打听消息啊。

say:8:1122204006:1.text: Who do you want info on? Give me a name, and I'll name a price.
say:8:1122204006:1.source_cn: 您想问谁，可以直说，也方便我给您报个价。
say:8:1122204006:1.male: Who do you want info on? Give me a name, and I'll name a price.
say:8:1122204006:1.female: Who do you want info on? Give me a name, and I'll name a price.

say:11:1122204008:1.text: You want info on that? Just letting you know, that won't come cheap. It'll cost... this much!
say:11:1122204008:1.source_cn: 当然。不过这伙人的消息，价格可不低。至少得要……这个数！

say:12:1122204009:1.text: T-three thousand gold?! That's so much!

say:13:1122204010:1.text: Hey, good intel is priceless! And looking at you, handling all those big bounties, you should be swimming in cash.
say:13:1122204010:1.source_cn: 话不能这样说。像您这种有能力接手巨额悬赏的客人，出手一...
say:13:1122204010:1.male: Hey, good intel is priceless! And looking at you, handling all those big bounties, you should be swimming in cash.
say:13:1122204010:1.female: Hey, good intel is priceless! And looking at you, handling all those big bounties, you should be swimming in cash.

say:14:1122204011:1.text: And if that's too much for you all at once, I'm willing to let you pay in installments. And I only charge 40% interest! That's super fair, right?
say:14:1122204011:1.source_cn: 而且，我也可以接受分期付款，只收四成利息。财物抵押或是...

choice_prompt:15:1122204011.text: And if that's too much for you all at once, I'm willing to let you pay in installments. And I only charge 40% interest! That's super fair, right?
choice_prompt:15:1122204011.source_cn: 而且，我也可以接受分期付款，只收四成利息。财物抵押或是少量赊账也没问题。

say:16:1122204012:1.text: You mean... you want me as your regular informant?
say:16:1122204012:1.source_cn: 您指的是……收买我当您的线人？
say:16:1122204012:1.male: You mean... you want me as your regular informant?
say:16:1122204012:1.female: You mean... you want me as your regular informant?

say:17:1122204013:1.text: Hmm. I don't know who's backing you, but this offer is quite tempting! You're the first person I've met in this town to play it so straight!
say:17:1122204013:1.source_cn: 虽然不知道您背后是哪方势力，但这个提议……着实令人心动...
say:17:1122204013:1.male: Hmm. I don't know who's backing you, but this offer is quite tempting! You're the first person I've met in this town to play it so straight!
say:17:1122204013:1.female: Hmm. I don't know who's backing you, but this offer is quite tempting! You're the first person I've met in this town to play it so straight!

say:18:1122204014:1.text: In that case, I won't waste any more of your time. Lemme tell ya, I've dealt with them before but I have no idea where their camp is located.
say:18:1122204014:1.source_cn: 既然如此，我也不啰嗦。那帮盗匪的确在我这买过不少好东西...

say:19:1122204015:1.text: Though judging by their moves, they're likely by the <style="highlight">southeast of town</style>.
say:19:1122204015:1.source_cn: 不过看他们出现的方向，大概率在<style=highl...

say:20:1122204016:1.text: By the way, they got a few guys <style="highlight">posing as merchants</style> at the <style="highlight">horse ranch to the east</style>. Those guys are in charge of recruiting.

say:21:1122204017:1.text: You could head over and feel them out if you're feeling brave. But don't blow your cover! I need you alive to return with my reward!
say:21:1122204017:1.source_cn: 要是胆子够大，您可以直接去探探他们的口风。只是得多加小...
say:21:1122204017:1.male: You could head over and feel them out if you're feeling brave. But don't blow your cover! I need you alive to return with my reward!
say:21:1122204017:1.female: You could head over and feel them out if you're feeling brave. But don't blow your cover! I need you alive to return with my reward!

choice:15:0:1.text: Let's think a bit more long-term.
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 我们可以长期合作，定期结款
choice:15:0:1.male: Let's think a bit more long-term.
choice:15:0:1.female: Let's think a bit more long-term.

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 偷走红沙棘货物的盗匪，你认识吧？

choice:6:0:1.text: I'm looking for a certain group.
choice:6:0:1.male: I'm looking for a certain group.
choice:6:0:1.female: I'm looking for a certain group.

say:23:1122204005:1.text: Ah, got it! You're looking for some information, right? No problem!
say:23:1122204005:1.source_cn: 噢——我知道了，您想买情报对吧？好说，好说！
say:23:1122204005:1.male: Ah, got it! You're looking for some information, right? No problem!
say:23:1122204005:1.female: Ah, got it! You're looking for some information, right? No problem!

choice:6:1:2.text: I'm not looking for physical items.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 我们不是来买枪和火药的
choice:6:1:2.male: I'm not looking for physical items.
choice:6:1:2.female: I'm not looking for physical items.
